response.justification: Bogdan brings strong distributed systems experience, deep full-stack proficiency in Python-adjacent ecosystems (TypeScript/Node.js), and direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure — aligning well with the role’s core requirements. His operational ownership, open-source leadership, and agile practices demonstrate the mindset needed. However, his Python expertise is implied rather than explicit, and his German language limitation may slightly hinder stakeholder alignment in a Berlin-based team.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq
Deep distributed systems background from high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby and Optilyz
Strong operational ownership demonstrated via open-source projects, CI/CD setup, and on-call-like maintenance
concerns: Python expertise not explicitly detailed despite being a must-have
German language skills are basic, potentially limiting stakeholder collaboration in Berlin
Lack of clear evidence of AI/ML product experience beyond infrastructure tooling
